title: Constitution Day Delhi protest opposes sir, demands Gyanesh Kumar removal

ai.summary: Delhi residents protested on Constitution Day against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list recheck, demanding removal of Gyanesh Kumar, the election commission's head.

facts.claim: Delhi residents protested on Constitution Day against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list recheck
facts.quote: Constitution Day Delhi protest opposes sir, demands Gyanesh Kumar removal

ai.background_note: The Special Intensive Revision is the Election Commission's house-to-house recheck of India's voter lists. Voters must link themselves, or a parent, to the roll from their state's last such revision two decades ago.
